name: Natsu no Yoin no Naka de
source:
Medical inspection shows signs of illness, so doctor advises to rest in quiet pleasant atmosphere like hometown. Main character takes enough medicine with him and heads North.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
体检显示有疾病迹象，因此医生建议在家乡等安静宜人的氛围中休息。主角带着足够的药物向北前进。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
